label: Lab 06
title: Which model should review your code?
question: Which models catch the bugs in a code change, which raise false alarms on changes that were fine, and what does our own reviewer turn down?
how: Four models review the same changes, twice each, alongside a reviewer that runs as a tool, recounted from the records the experiments saved in the repository. We add the review verdicts on this site's own pull requests.
status: Measured · each count recounted from the repository records
